lead.headline: Taylor on the block, Jacobs under review — Bloodsports win anyway
lead.deck: 1-6, heading to 2-6: 137.98 to 82.40 with Loveland tonight. Nothing moved since the morning; no claim is worth priority.
lead.body: The bad news is two starters with outside problems. Jonathan Taylor scored 6.7 in a 42-7 loss and the Colts are in "active and ongoing" trade talks for him, having turned down a second-round pick (B/R 31 Oct); a Broncos report on Sunday is unconfirmed (Heavy via Yahoo 2 Nov), and Indianapolis have not named a Week 9 quarterback. Josh Jacobs may still be suspended when the NFL review ends (Heavy 1 Nov). This week is won: Tuten 29.9, Jacobs 23.2 and Golden 20.9, with the Jaguars D/ST adding 19. Loveland plays tonight with no designation; nothing is left to set.
